clips.send: Send to a friend who can't explain why certain headlines send them into a rage - the switch they didn't know was there, a jolt of unease.
clips.caption:
Ever snap over something that was not even a big deal?

Kevin calls it a button - an old emotional imprint (the Sanskrit word is Samskara) sitting in memory, waiting to be pushed. Whoever writes the headlines knows where yours is. Feed you enough conflict and fear, and the button fires - for a few minutes you are not driving your own reactions.

He has watched two friends with opposite politics argue, then go watch football together - because neither one had a button left to push.

Comment RISE and I will send you how to find yours.
